notes.content: The page proposes calling an n-category special or n-galoisienne when it is n-equivalent to locally constant (n-1)-champs on a suitable space or topos, or to n-functors from an n-groupoid to (n-Cat). It names the corresponding fundamental n-groupoid, local n-systems, and geometric realization. It then proposes recovering the groupoid inside an underlined Hom n-category by exactness conditions, tentatively mentioning finite inverse limits and arbitrary direct limits. It says the n=2 case is becoming familiar and ends mid-sentence.
